verdict.rationale: Xero publishes a documented public API through its developer portal. It also maintains official OpenAPI (Swagger) specs with an OAuth 2.0 security schema, official SDKs such as xero-node generated from those specs, Custom Connections for machine-to-machine integrations, and an official MCP server and AI toolkit for agent use. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents can drive the API in practice (all evidence is first-party).
